builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 Q deals 250 + 1.45 bonus AD physical damage. Bonus AD is the lever, not attack speed or critical chance. Bloodthirster and earned Hubris raise that coefficient; flat and percent penetration compete against the fixed target armor. The armor reduction applied by Q must not be retroactively credited to the initial hit without verifying event order.

builds.name: Martial Cadence: current-health penetration test

builds.hypothesis: The passive adds 8% target current HP physical with a per-target cooldown. Current HP is sampled at the actual hit; setup damage that lowers it changes the starting coefficient.
